This '''''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer''' was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wankle]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It patrolled near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], and conducted cargo inspections of ships entering and exiting the system.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Star Destroyer first appeared in the story ''[[Bungo n' Rusti Get Carry-Out]]'' that appeared in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 11]], written by [[James Anderson|Jim Anderson]].

In material Anderson released on TheForce.Net, he revealed that the Star Destroyer was named the ''Excessive''.<ref name="Wankle bio">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/comics/fancomics/bungo&rusti/wankle.html|text=Jim Anderson's Wankle's biography|archivedate=20041213043818}}</ref> However, no official source has confirmed this name.
